_source: ARRL, "Section Boundaries" — the divisions, their sections, and the counties that constitute each section.
_note: Transcribed from ARRL's published list, kept as comma-separated strings in the same order ARRL prints them so a reader can diff this against the source page line by line.

Three fixes are applied at build time rather than here, so this file stays a faithful copy: ARRL spells Northampton PA as 'Northhampton'; ARRL still calls Miami-Dade FL 'Dade' (renamed 1997); and ARRL's Southern New Jersey list is missing a comma, printing 'Mercer Ocean' for two counties.
Los Angeles is the only section ARRL gives no county list for, because it is exactly Los Angeles County.
Ontario is absent: GH/ONE/ONN/ONS are RAC sections, not ARRL ones, and are not in this document.
